messages:
keisha-peopleops: Heads-up: Elior (UK remote, joining from Israel) accepted offer. Hiring asks for comp uplift band5->band6 and benefits to start 2026-11-02 (candidates preferred start). Payroll enrollment earliest available 2026-11-16 due to international onboarding window. Can we approve retroactive coverage + expedited equity paperwork?

dan-hiring: Manager says candidate is critical to cross-region infra work and has a competing offer. Offer signed verbally; we offered band5 but manager requests band6 to match. Candidate insists on benefits from day one.

tobias-finance: Financials: uplift ~A38,700 annualized. International payroll has an extra admin lead-time (work authorization + tax docs). Retroactive pension/benefits backfill is possible but requires documented authorizations and CFO sign-off. There may be small one-time payroll tax adjustments.

meera-legal: From legal: cross-border start means we must confirm employment location + tax residency. We can put benefits effective 11/02 if the signed offer lists that start date. For retroactive employer contributions across jurisdictions, plan admin and local law vary; recommend limiting retro to 10 business days and adding an exception memo referencing candidate's signed docs. Also need attested copy of work-authorization before first payroll.

yusuf-talent: Candidate is willing to sign contingent language if it speeds things up. Suggest we offer interim vendor health coverage from 11/02 while payroll processes pensions. Talent can pay vendor invoice if company declines, but better if company covers to secure candidate.

keisha-peopleops: Proposed flow: 1) Approve provisional band6 pending CFO confirmation. 2) Approve benefits retroactive to start up to 10 business days. 3) If payroll enrollment delayed >7 calendar days, People Ops to provision vendor health coverage from day one. 4) Legal to confirm equity grant effective date can match start if board/compliance cleared. Approve?

tobias-finance: Conditional OK, will ping Maria-CFO. Need a short cost note including NI/social contributions and payroll code to track (use code PY-INT-1126). I'll send numbers in 1 hour.

dan-hiring: Please push CFO approval, candidate needs a formal offer letter today or they may accept counteroffer.

meera-legal: Please upload signed PDF offer (effective 2026-11-02) to legal@redwood. I will draft exception wording: "Benefits enrollment retroactive to start date not to exceed 10 business days; any cross-border payroll tax adjustments to be recorded under PY-INT-1126." Approve?

hr-ops-bot: Tasks created: "collect-signed-offer" -> @dan-hiring (due 2026-10-30); "calc-uplift-and-tax" -> @tobias-finance (due 2026-10-30); "provision-vendor-health-if-needed" -> @keisha-peopleops (due 2026-11-02).

keisha-peopleops: I'll hold uplift approval until CFO sign-off. Dan, please upload sign. Yusuf, can you confirm vendor health cost estimate?

yusuf-talent: Vendor cost for UK-plan proxy ~A3120/month. If company covers from day one for up to 2 weeks that's ~A340. Candidate ok with company covering interim.

tobias-finance: Maria-CFO: ping. Quick summary: uplift annual delta ~A38,700; payroll code PY-INT-1126 for the retro; retro cap 10 business days. Approve?

maria-cfo: (via DM) Reviewed. Approve provisional band6 and benefits retro up to 10 business days. Finance to absorb payroll adj under PY-INT-1126. Equity effective date contingent on legal confirming grant paperwork.

tobias-finance: CFO approved. I'll post the short cost memo now.

meera-legal: Received signed offer via email. Drafted exception memo and grant note. Approve exception language: "People Ops and Finance approve retroactive benefits enrollment to 2026-11-02 for candidate Elior, limited to 10 business days; cross-border payroll adjustments tracked to PY-INT-1126; equity grant date contingent on plan admin confirmation."

keisha-peopleops: Approve the wording. Issuing updated formal offer PDF now and routing to HR records. Provisioning vendor health coverage from 2026-11-02 as fallback. Exception filed EXC-2026-327.

dan-hiring: Candidate signed and sent timestamped PDF at 09:18. Manager confirms ramp plan.

hr-ops-bot: Tasks completed: "collect-signed-offer" by @dan-hiring (timestamp 2465432200); "calc-uplift-and-tax" by @tobias-finance (timestamp 2465432212); "provision-vendor-health-if-needed" by @keisha-peopleops (timestamp 2465432220).

keisha-peopleops: Closing thread. Noting cross-border docs in HR file and cc'ing comp, payroll, legal. :white_check_mark:
